submission.justification: Absorber-F2 with 4 mm plate thickness offers the best energy resolution at 100 GeV among all tested options (3.212%), satisfying the primary goal. It also meets all project constraints: the material is from the approved candidate list, the thickness is within 2–10 mm, and hands-on maintenance constraints were found to be satisfied.

requirements.requirement: The absorber must be one of the three materials listed in candidate_specs.md.
requirements.evidence: Absorber-F2 is among the tested candidate materials.

requirements.requirement: The calorimeter must allow hands-on maintenance during shutdowns.
requirements.evidence: No maintenance constraint violations were found (maintenance_found_constraints = 0).
Chosen plate thickness is 4 mm, within the specified range.
